newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends up, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends up, seen stable.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight interbank rate closed slightly firmer on Friday, triggered by demand for routine monthly payments, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 4.971 percent against Thursday's 4.928 close, with 30-day commercial paper stable at 4.95-5.00.
But dealers expected liquidity to remain relatively stable next week on maturation of T$45 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit.
The interbank rate is expected to fluctuate at around 5.000-125 percent.
The bond market was quiet in the afternoon as the market continued a consolidation. But dealers said buying interest may emerge next week in 15-year government bonds.
